entities.name: Talas
entities.description: Dark-skinned human people of western Caliman, merchants, pirates and wizards with steam-powered galleons and airships.

entities.name: Caliman
entities.description: Continent on Dominaria whose west coast is the region of Talas.

entities.name: Norwood
entities.description: Elven forest from which the Talas harvested featherwood.
